note: The text weaves together several distinct origin myths (sky-lifting, a sea-origin tale of siblings and their angry mother, and the hero Qat's canoe-flood); the flood proper is a localized island deluge caused by rain filling a central hollow and bursting out as a waterfall, with Qat saving his family and representative animals in a specially built canoe, after which he and the canoe vanish out to sea with promise of future return.
name: New Hebrides
